daily_budget_usd.description: Per-agent cost ceiling in USD/day (a cap, not a spend forecast). Summed and projected to a 30-day month by scripts/roster-cost-gate.py against PLATFORM_MONTHLY_BUDGET_USD in docker-compose.yml. See docs/design/roster-cost-gate.md.

mcp_servers.description: MCP servers this role may use, by registry name (agents/mcp-registry.json). Every name must be registered; validate_profiles.py enforces it. The platform renders only the servers named in AAF_MCP_SERVERS at boot, so a grant here is a declared intent the deployment must also enable.
